title: [R3-runtime C] Extract the PRD reader and close PRD hostile arms
description: SPIDR child C of task-cb40f3d833f14c3089d812b9bf2d291f, authorized by governor ruling comment-bfb2ead85631448db049a5ea7a5fbe9f after parent reachability block comment-62aa06055c374bc9888c06b6d8af9a6c. This is the PRD_LOCAL_LAYER producer+hostile-arm seam and the serialized extension of child A's runtime-provider receipt. Exact owned paths (3): apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/use-goal-prd.ts; apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/new-goal-form.test.tsx; tests/security/runtime-provider-control-room.security.ts. It extracts one production PRD reader used by the real hook, enforces the browser size/read fences, and proves a superseded late read cannot publish stale bytes. It preserves child A's SESSION_KEY_LAYER arms and does not edit the master roster or runtime-provider partition.
definitionOfDone: Verify from epicSiblings that child A task-d152f559bc2e4c9785f343ede125dcd8 is DONE and inspect its landed runtime-provider-control-room.security.ts receipt/SESSION_KEY arms before editing. At current HEAD measure all useGoalPrd/PRD_LOCAL_LAYER callers and exact reason/shape/count assertions, run the existing new-goal-form PRD tests standalone with a nonzero count, and record all three owned paths' baseline status without treating foreign WIP as a blocker.

Red-first extract an exported, typed production PRD-file reader in use-goal-prd.ts and call it from useGoalPrd rather than reimplementing it in the test. The reader checks PRD_FILE_PREFLIGHT_MAX_BYTES before File.text(), so an oversized file never reads bytes and returns PRD_FILE_TOO_LARGE at CONTROL_ROOM_NEWGOAL; a within-bound file whose text() rejects returns PRD_FILE_UNREADABLE at CONTROL_ROOM_NEWGOAL. Successful bytes still produce the current exact name/size/text/SHA-256/media-type draft without any selection-time daemon request.

Keep last-selection authority in the hook with a monotonically increasing generation/token: selecting a second file clears the first pending publication, and neither a late text completion nor late digest completion from the superseded file may set prd, submittedPrd, or READ. Add a deterministic form-level race where selection one is deferred-valid, selection two is current-but-unreadable, then selection one resolves; the final production state remains the exact PRD_FILE_UNREADABLE@CONTROL_ROOM_NEWGOAL refusal with no stale bytes in the draft or DOM.

Extend tests/security/runtime-provider-control-room.security.ts without weakening child A: the local owned set and literal denominator cover exactly SESSION_KEY_LAYER and PRD_LOCAL_LAYER, each with nonzero BEFORE/AFTER/RACE cases. PRD BEFORE proves oversize avoids text(), AFTER proves a valid-size read throw maps to the exact code/layer, and RACE drives the real hook/reader path so the superseded successful bytes cannot publish over the current refusal. The focused file writes one valid receipt; BOUNDARY_ROSTER and runtime-provider-invariants remain untouched for the serialized final roster row.

Mutation-drill the production pre-read size guard, read-error mapping, generation comparison, and one literal generated-arm denominator; each named arm reds, then tracked-path restore is proven. Run standalone/unpiped focused new-goal-form and runtime-provider-control-room gates with nonzero Test Files/Tests counts, @moe/control-room typecheck/package tests, and disclose any expected full-security completeness red from the not-yet-serialized master roster by merge-base-versus-HEAD owned-path attribution.

implementationPlan.description: Extract the minimum browser-local production reader and make the real hook consume it. Export the narrow refusal-code union (`PRD_FILE_TOO_LARGE | PRD_FILE_UNREADABLE`), `PrdFileReadResult`, and `readGoalPrdFile(file: File): Promise<PrdFileReadResult>` where success is `{status:'READ', prd, submittedPrd}` and refusal is the exact existing `{status:'ERROR',code,layer}` shape. The reader must compare `file.size > PRD_FILE_PREFLIGHT_MAX_BYTES` before its first `file.text()`/digest operation, map text/digest rejection to `PRD_FILE_UNREADABLE @ CONTROL_ROOM_NEWGOAL`, and on success reuse `prdMediaType` plus the current SHA-256 implementation to produce the unchanged exact PRD and GoalDraftPrd bytes. Refactor `useGoalPrd.acceptFile` to clear `prd`/`submittedPrd`, increment one monotonic generation per non-null selection, call only this reader (no duplicated size/read/digest logic), and compare the captured generation after the whole reader settles before publishing either success or refusal. Thus a superseded read or digest completion publishes nothing, while the current unreadable selection remains authoritative. Keep selection browser-only: no fetch/client/daemon call, durable write, goal-wire change, new refusal code, or BOUNDARY_ROSTER edit. Retain the hook's returned state shape and keep the production source below 250 physical lines.
